Market Data

 

The Definitive Dataset for Global Semiconductor Shipments

Track the semiconductor market with the most timely and comprehensive shipment dataset

The World Semiconductor Trade Statistics (WSTS) publishes industry-wide monthly shipment data—value, units, average sales prices. Shipments are broken down by semiconductor product type, end-use, and region of shipment to end-customer, distributor, or consignee when possible. All WSTS datapoints are collected from member companies directly.

Our dashboard transforms over 35 years of WSTS shipment data into an insightful business intelligence tool. Designed for deep market analysis, the platform provides an intuitive interface for navigating 200+ granular reporting categories, offering a comprehensive view of the global semiconductor landscape. The dashboard helps users identify cyclical trends, benchmark regional performance, and track market developments with minimal friction.

Monthly Shipments


Track market developments with the most recent datapoints available

Industry forecasts


Includes industry forecasts for the next 3 calendar years

Historic Data


Use and apply semiconductor shipment data going back to 1976
Dataset overview

WSTS publishes monthly reports showing  shipments data—revenue, units, and ASPs—for a range of semiconductor products, end-uses, and regions. WSTS includes over 216 breakouts that disaggregate data by products, end-uses, and regions.

Data source and validity

The WSTS collects data directly from its 49 member companies who are required to report monthly.  Member companies report to the WSTS through regional data collection agents that aggregate and anonymize provided data before transmitting it to the WSTS.

Please visit the WSTS for more information about how the organization generates and produces its reports

Semiconductor coverage

WSTS does produce a classification guide that is available to subscribers. A quick summary breakout is provided below with some sample product breakouts available.

  • Logic—microprocessors, microcontrollers, digital signal processors
  • Memory—DRAM, NAND, SRAM
  • Analog—Amplifiers/comparators, signal conversion, interface ICs
  • Discrete—Diodes, small signal transistors, power transistors
  • Optoelectronics—CCD Image sensors, CMOS image sensors, laser diodes
  • Sensors and Actuators—temperature, pressure, acceleration, and actuators
Report types
  • Bluebook monthly reports
  • Greenbook monthly reports
  • Biannual industry forecasts
Coverage history
  • WSTS data has monthly shipment data going as far  back as far as 1976.
  • Biannual industry forecasts date back to 2000.

Frequently asked questions

Why should my organization subscribe to WSTS?

The WSTS is the only primary source for sales data about the semiconductor markets directly from industry participants.

  • WSTS monthly reports are the most current indicator of industry performance.
  • WSTS forecasts provide subscribers with a leading indicator on the industry’s expected performance for the next 3 calendar years.
  • Subscriptions include access to historical data going back to 1976
Can our firm subscribe to the WSTS?

Yes, all organizations may become WSTS subscribers—except for companies engaged in semiconductor front-end fabrication.

If your company performs semiconductor front-end manufacturing, we would direct you to connect with the WSTS about possible membership.

 

How can my organization use the WSTS data?

Organizations can use WSTS data for internal analysis and may conduct derivative analyses for use in client newsletters or similar external communications. Subscribers are prohibited from the external reproduction and/or redistribution of WSTS data.

What is the frequency of data releases?

WSTS monthly reports are released within 5 weeks of a month’s end.

How many user licenses are in a standard institutional license?

SIA user agreement terms for institutions allow for up to 10 users to get direct access to the platform. Each user account is intended for a single-user and cannot be shared by multiple users.

What is the cost of subscription?

Please contact SIA either with the form below or by emailing us at [email protected] for pricing information.
